summary: The trimmed three-cap lemma is valid, including p=0 and support-face cases: the continuous trim leaves area q-D+p, each covering halfplane cuts the trimmed body in area at most p, and the planar centroid inequality yields 4(q-D+p)<=9p. The halfplane cover follows exactly from f1+f2+f3=-1, the empty-full identities give the admissible parameter p=t-m, and the contact-tail condition gives C>=p. The scalar identities and rearrangement are exact. Accepted fact 15bb2c1680a0254e supplies M<m+k via its strict residual inequality s>1-r after identifying a1=k, so the final contradiction is valid.
